REGISTRATION_DESIGN_DEFECT: P3's categories were OVERLAP versus SEPARATE. P3 is recorded as failed as written; the differentiated-role reading requires a fresh registration and untouched material.

RESCORED_r429_AGAINST_PER_ENDPOINT_NOISE.WHAT_THIS_OVERTURNS: P3 was reported FAILED, and that failure is the sole reason mechanism hypothesis 4 was abandoned. MECHANISM HYPOTHESIS 4 IS REINSTATED AS LIVE.
RESCORED_r429_AGAINST_PER_ENDPOINT_NOISE.hypothesis_4_restated: in terminal swing the spastic reflex keeps gastrocnemius active; because gastrocnemius spans the knee that activity opposes knee extension; the knee therefore arrives at initial contact incompletely extended. Soleus, which does not span the knee, shows no corresponding terminal-swing difference -- and on the corrected scoring it does not.
what_still_stands_against_it: P2, the mediator itself, clears its floor by only 1.8x. The chain's weakest link is the gastrocnemius activation difference, not the torque or the soleus control.
SPANNING_RESULT_r421 shows single-muscle lesions displacing joints their muscle does not cross (hip at 3.9x its floor, both muscles). A knee-spanning story does not explain that.
correlation along a chain is not mediation; r408 section 6.1 said so at registration and that limit is unchanged.

r407's direct single-muscle decomposition at matched dose is the experiment that would settle it. r421 finally ran it and found separation at every joint, which is evidence AGAINST a clean knee-spanning mediation even though it does not touch these terminal-swing numbers.
RESCORED_r429_AGAINST_PER_ENDPOINT_NOISE.status: LIVE BUT UNRESOLVED. RESCORED_r429_AGAINST_PER_ENDPOINT_NOISE.process_note: found by rescoring every mechanism claim against a per-endpoint floor after the user asked whether the mechanism evidence was strong. Three scoring errors in this corpus share one cause: a number was called an effect without being divided by the noise floor for its own endpoint.
RESCORED_r429_AGAINST_PER_ENDPOINT_NOISE.CRITERION_CHANGE_DISCLOSURE_r438: PREREG_terminalswing_r408.md section 5 registered P3 as an OVERLAP OF RANGES. The ranges are disjoint, so P3 FAILS AS REGISTERED and that is the verdict of record. RESCORED_r429 replaced the registered criterion with a comparison against a noise floor that did not exist at registration time. That is a POST-HOC CRITERION CHANGE and it was the sole basis on which hypothesis 4 was revived. Disclosed, not defended. Hypothesis 4 was afterwards killed on independent grounds at MEDIATION_RESULT_r431 (both torque links indistinguishable from zero), so nothing downstream rests on the revival.
